experiment: MR34I7 — same-runner fresh-process AVX512F disable, original NumPy kernel forensic comparison

controlled_intervention.implementation: Two distinct original Python3.11/NumPy1.26.4 processes sequentially on the SAME allocated physical GitHub job; default NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES UNSET; disabled environment NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES=AVX512F before interpreter starts.

fail_closed_checks: Exact original Git and blob identity, all three original checkouts clean
First created protocol commit must precede execution workflow, and contain no workflow/code
Both modes see identical 490 original binary64 inputs and reproduce MR34I4 first-public-logit original source hashes
Disabled arm must have numpy runtime __cpu_features__.AVX512F false; if already false in default mark intervention NOT_ELIGIBLE, not a positive
All four jobs have both fresh-interpreter original kernel receipts; paired separate-process CPU platform identity must match
Any changed upstream original source/model/feature/held identity blocks numeric-portability claims

An AVX512F cause requires a true available->disabled feature transition on a same-host pair AND corresponding exp difference AND reproducible disabled outputs cross-host; mere correlation or green jobs is not causal evidence
Preserve prior results, no rounding to create equality and no model numerical semantics change

decision_rules.NO_INTERVENTION: No same-host runner had AVX512F enabled in default and successfully disabled in the second process; diagnostic executed but causal AVX512F test NOT ELIGIBLE
decision_rules.DISABLE_NO_EFFECT: At least one eligible same-host pair; output exp/sigmoid bytes unchanged in that pair; hypothesized AVX512F flag alone not supported for these frozen values
decision_rules.DISABLE_EFFECT_UNPORTABLE: Eligible pair shows altered bytes but disabled-mode across 4 hosts not identical on all 490 source inputs; not portable
decision_rules.AVX512F_DISPATCH_POSSIBLE: Eligible pair changes result and full disabled-mode 4-host results identical, including Decimal; evidence consistent with AVX512F dispatch role, but unique CPU instruction cause not proven
decision_rules.SOURCE_IDENTITY_FAIL: Original source/model or input SHA changed; reject any math portability result

scientific_claims: NONE; candidate untrained first-public-logit numeric diagnostic, not mid-trained original divergent u, not checkpoint qualification or unfamiliar-task transfer
